title: Calorie target
summary: A base daily budget, with corrections to single days.
description: Settings holds a base budget for every day. A single day can be corrected, so that room moves between days inside a week.

stories.want: to take the difference off the next days
stories.soThat: the week still comes out level

stories.want: a checkmark on the nutrients I aim for next to my calorie target
stories.soThat: I can see at a glance whether I have had enough of them

requirements.text: A day's target is the base budget plus that day's correction, but never below `goal.min-target`; a correction applies to its own day only.

history.text: A day's target is the base budget plus that day's correction; a correction applies to its own day only.
history.reason: Version 1 left out the floor of GOAL-4.

requirements.text: A multi-day period's target is the base budget times its days; corrections do not change it.
A correction entered on the Diary is limited to `goal.max-correction` either way.

history.text: A correction is at most `goal.max-correction` either way.
history.reason: The limit is applied where a correction is entered, not to a correction already stored.

requirements.text: A multi-day period's target has no floor.

history.text: A day's target never falls below `goal.min-target`; a multi-day period's target has no floor.
history.reason: Version 1 restated the day floor, which GOAL-1 states.

requirements.text: Tally has no achievements or rewards tied to staying under a daily calorie budget.
In Settings → Goals the user picks the nutrients to check off, each with a daily amount of their own; none are picked until they do.

The Calorie target card lists each picked nutrient with a checkmark when what was taken in over the shown period, food and supplements together, reaches its daily amount times the period's days, and an empty mark when it doesn't.
